## Mount workflow

When a project source set is attached:

1. read local START / CONTINUE;
2. read STATE / HANDOFF;
3. read AGENTS / constitution;
4. identify canonical source roots and repository authority split;
5. identify active lineage/frontier;
6. compare with prior harvest capsule;
7. inspect changed/dependency-affected sources first;
8. emit a dense ProjectHarvestCapsule delta;
9. route reusable objects through the Ω lattice admission membrane;
10. use visible BridgeCapsules/files for cross-notebook transfer.

```text
NOTEBOOK != STATION
NOTEBOOK_CHAT != CANONICAL_MEMORY
CROSS_NOTEBOOK_MEMORY != ASSUMED
SOURCE_PROJECT_CANON != OMEGA_AGGREGATE_VIEW
MOUNT != OWNERSHIP_TRANSFER
SOURCE_ATTACHMENT != AUTHORITY_PROMOTION
```
